strings.Все люди, документы и события этого дела: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. The group personal insurance meets the first paragraph of Part 2.1 of Article 7 of Law No. 353-ФЗ. The bank is the policyholder; Maria is the insured borrower. Full early repayment is confirmed, and there have been no events bearing signs of an insured event. Of the total charge of 40 000 roubles, the premium paid to the insurer for Maria is 30 000, while another bank charge of 10 000 is shown separately. The legality and possible refund of that other service have not been predetermined. The bank received the application for removal from coverage after repayment.
